meta.title: Code Toolkit
meta.description: Five commands: three checks that run in the current session by default (add sub for an isolated agent) — code review behind an eight-gate filter, behavior-preserving simplification that plans by default, and privacy scrubbing that reports masked findings and only rewrites when you choose Rewrite — plus a caption loop that installs an explicit observe/verify/record cycle into the current session, and /pua, which installs a protocol for changing method and showing evidence instead of shrugging. Prompts are organised as a layered skill-style tree, with a deterministic test suite and a model evaluation loop.
